text_block_list.text:
Through pure tenacity, Нарита Таисин
manages to
win the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the mistakes made в тренировке
lead to her
breaking under the weight of
her mental and
physical exhaustion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She confesses that she needs a break
from both
training and racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
